Overview.Title: Scheduler operations
Overview.Description: Follow workload volume, execution outcomes, recent activity, and attention signals before drilling into deployment evidence.

Catalog.Title: Job catalog
Catalog.Description: Browse recurring and triggered work separately, read schedule health, and open a job's complete operational dossier.

JobDetail.Title: Job operational dossier
JobDetail.Description: Read one immutable declaration alongside its effective policy, schedule cursor, worker compatibility, and latest execution evidence.

Executions.Title: Durable execution ledger
Executions.Description: Search queued and completed work, inspect fenced lease history, and request cancellation without relying on broker delivery.

Statistics.Title: Scheduler analytics
Statistics.Description: Measure reliability, schedule fulfillment, throughput, duration percentiles, and workload concentration over bounded scheduler-time windows.

Access.DeniedDescription: Your current account is not authorized to inspect or operate JobScheduler.

ExecutionSkipReasons.RecurringCapacityUnavailable: Outstanding execution capacity was unavailable at this occurrence.

Release.TransitionMessage: New execution admission and recurring materialization are paused until the complete desired release is activated.
Release.ReadinessDescription: Desired publication and exact worker revisions must converge before the release can become the active execution contract.

Queue.Title: Execution state
Queue.Description: Current durable ledger distribution by lifecycle state.

Attention.Title: Needs attention
Attention.Description: Signals that may require an operator decision.
Attention.ClearDescription: No failed or skipped executions and every source project is converged.
Attention.OwnersDescription: Publication or compatible workers are missing.

Analytics.Title: Performance analytics
Analytics.Description: Explore throughput, outcome trends, duration percentiles, and the slowest jobs over a bounded time window.

Deployment.Title: Deployment evidence
Deployment.Description: Release epochs and worker convergence remain available below the workload pulse for deep operational diagnosis.

Owners.Title: Owner convergence
Owners.Description: A release is operational only when each expected declaration snapshot and matching worker revision are present.
Owners.Empty: No owners are present in the desired release.

Detail.Title: Owner details
Detail.ReadyDescription: The required snapshot and matching worker revision are present. This owner signal does not by itself mean the desired release is active.
Detail.WaitingDescription: A declaration snapshot or matching worker revision is still missing. Release activation is evaluated separately.
Detail.SnapshotReadyDescription: The expected immutable declaration snapshot is available.
Detail.SnapshotWaitingDescription: The expected declaration snapshot has not been published.
Detail.WorkersDescription: Active leases matching the expected revision.
Detail.DefinitionsDescription: Jobs from this exact owner revision in the active catalog.
Detail.RevisionDescription: Worker capabilities must report this exact executable revision.
Detail.ReleaseDescription: Owner readiness and catalog activation are independent signals.
Detail.JobsDescription: Definitions in the active catalog owned by this exact worker revision.
Detail.JobsEmpty: No matching definitions are present in the active catalog.

Recent.Title: Recent queue activity
Recent.Description: The newest durable execution admissions across all jobs.
Recent.Empty: No executions have been admitted yet.

Catalog.Title: Job definitions
Catalog.Empty: No active definitions match the current filters.

Actions.PauseUnavailableDebug: Automatic materialization is already suppressed by debug mode. Use Run job now for an explicit execution.
Actions.RunDuringDebug: Run job now remains available because explicit admission does not advance the recurring cursor.

Lifecycle.OperatorPausedDescription: Operator policy prevents automatic recurring materialization.
Lifecycle.DebugSuppressedDescription: Debug mode suppresses automatic materialization; explicit Run job now remains available.
Lifecycle.OperatorAndDebugDescription: Operator policy and debug mode both suppress automatic recurring materialization.
Lifecycle.AwaitingDescription: The recurring cursor is waiting for the active declaration to synchronize.
Lifecycle.ExhaustedDescription: No automatic occurrence remains within the declared schedule boundaries.
Lifecycle.TriggeredEnabledDescription: Operator admission is enabled for this triggered job.
Lifecycle.TriggeredDisabledDescription: Operator policy blocks new admissions for this triggered job.

NextRun.DueNow: The next occurrence is due now.

Selection.SelectAll: Select all recurring jobs on this page
Selection.Description: Batch changes retain each job's independent retention policy and optimistic concurrency fence.
Selection.DebugPauseUnavailable: One or more selected jobs already run in debug manual-only mode; quick Pause is unavailable for that selection.

Messages.Resumed: Recurring materialization will resume from the next future occurrence.
Messages.PauseUnavailableDebug: Automatic materialization is already suppressed by debug mode. Run job now remains available.
Messages.ResumedDebugRemains: Operator pause was cleared. Debug mode still keeps automatic materialization suppressed; Run job now remains available.
Messages.RunFailed: The job could not be queued.

Batch.Empty: Select at least one recurring job.
Batch.PauseMessage: Pause new recurring occurrences for {0} selected job(s)? Existing queued and running executions are unchanged.
Batch.ResumeMessage: Resume {0} selected job(s) from their next future occurrence? Disabled-period occurrences are not replayed.
Batch.PauseUnavailableDebug: Quick Pause is unavailable because one or more selected jobs are already suppressed by debug mode without an operator pause.
Batch.ResultDebugRemains: {0} operator pause update(s) succeeded; {1} failed. Debug mode still suppresses automatic materialization where configured.

Policy.Title: Operator policy
Policy.ImmutableNotice: Name, cron, timezone, concurrency, retry, timeout, and execution identity are declared by code and cannot be edited here. Disabling blocks new admission and recurring materialization; queued or running executions must be cancelled separately.
Policy.MaxRecordsHelp: Leave empty for no record-count limit.
Policy.MaxDaysHelp: Leave empty for no age limit.

JobDetail.NotFound: No active catalog declaration exists for {0}.

Activity.Title: Execution activity
Activity.Description: Newest running work and recent failures for this logical job.
Activity.RunningLoadFailed: Running executions could not be refreshed: {0}
Activity.FailuresDescription: Newest failed executions created during the 30-day health window.
Activity.FailuresLoadFailed: Recent failures could not be refreshed: {0}
Activity.FailuresEmpty: No recent failed execution was found.

Schedule.Title: Recurring schedule
Schedule.Description: The durable cursor uses this immutable schedule and the active policy to materialize occurrences.
Schedule.TriggeredDescription: This job has no recurring cursor. Operators admit an execution explicitly through the active catalog.
Schedule.DebugManualOnly: Debug mode is suppressing automatic occurrences. Run job now remains available and does not advance the recurring cursor.

StatusDescriptions.NotRecurring: No recurring cursor applies to an on-demand job.
StatusDescriptions.AwaitingSynchronization: The active declaration is waiting for the control plane to create its durable cursor.
StatusDescriptions.Scheduled: The durable cursor has a next occurrence ready for future materialization.
StatusDescriptions.Suspended: Operator policy has suspended new recurring occurrence materialization.
StatusDescriptions.Exhausted: No occurrence remains within the declared schedule boundaries.

SuspensionDescriptions.OperatorPolicy: Operator policy has paused automatic recurring occurrence materialization.
SuspensionDescriptions.DebugMode: Debug mode suppresses automatic occurrence materialization while preserving explicit Run job now admission.
SuspensionDescriptions.OperatorAndDebug: Operator policy and debug mode both suppress automatic occurrence materialization. Clearing the operator pause leaves debug suppression active.

Contract.Title: Declaration and policy contract
Contract.Description: Code-owned declaration fields remain immutable; operator policy is stored independently and updated with optimistic concurrency.
Contract.MaxConcurrencyHelp: Caps concurrent worker leases; recurring materialization also uses it as the queued-and-running overlap limit.
Contract.RetryCountHelp: Additional failed attempts allowed after the first attempt.
Contract.ExecutionTimeoutHelp: Maximum duration allowed for one execution attempt.
Contract.PolicyStampHelp: Optimistic-concurrency token; policy updates must match it and receive a new stamp.
Contract.ReleaseHelp: Immutable catalog release that supplied this active declaration.
Contract.ActivationEpochHelp: Monotonic epoch assigned when this release became the active execution contract.
Contract.WorkerRevisionHelp: Exact executable revision a compatible worker must advertise before it can claim this job.
Contract.JobRevisionHelp: Content identity of the immutable declaration captured by new executions.

LatestExecution.Title: Latest execution
LatestExecution.Description: Newest durable execution evidence for this logical job across catalog revisions.
LatestExecution.Empty: This job has not produced any durable execution yet.

Health.Title: Job health
Health.Description: Reliability, schedule delivery, terminal outcomes, and attempt duration are measured independently.
Health.ReliabilityFormulaHelp: Successful completions divided by successful plus failed completions; skipped and cancelled executions are excluded.
Health.FulfillmentFormulaHelp: Recurring schedule occurrences delivered to a worker, whether successful or failed, divided by delivered plus skipped occurrences. Triggered and operator run-now admissions are excluded.
Health.TriggeredFulfillmentNotApplicable: Triggered jobs have no automatic schedule to fulfill.
Health.OutcomeAriaLabel: Job execution outcomes created in the selected window
Health.CohortNote: Outcome tiles describe executions created in the window; reliability and duration use executions completed in the window.
Health.LoadFailed: Job health analytics could not be refreshed: {0}

CronInspector.Title: Schedule inspector
CronInspector.ImmutableNotice: This schedule belongs to the immutable release declaration. Change it in code and deploy a new catalog release; the inspector never mutates release history.

Expression.Title: Cron contract
Expression.Description: Six-field expressions include seconds; five-field expressions begin with minutes.
Expression.DraftHelp: Edit locally to validate and preview. The draft is not persisted; publish a new catalog release to change the immutable schedule.

Preview.Title: Upcoming declaration occurrences
Preview.Description: Calculated strictly after {0}; the durable cursor remains authoritative.
Preview.Unavailable: This host cannot evaluate the declared Cron expression or timezone.
Preview.Empty: No future occurrence remains within the declaration boundaries.

Trigger.Title: Admit execution
Trigger.ArgumentsUnknown: Enter a JSON object matching the job's declared argument contract.

Delay.Title: Queue availability
Delay.Description: Choose the first scheduler wall time at which a worker may claim this execution.
Delay.TimeZoneHelp: The selected wall time is interpreted in scheduler timezone {0} and persisted as UTC.
Delay.Required: Choose both a date and time.
Delay.InvalidWallTime: This wall time does not exist in scheduler timezone {0}. Choose another time.
Delay.Future: Delayed availability must be in the future.

Range.Title: Analysis window
Range.Description: Calendar presets use scheduler timezone {0}; database aggregation remains bounded.

Trend.Title: Outcome trend
Trend.Description: Completed outcomes across the selected range, presented in scheduler time.

Duration.Title: Terminal-attempt duration
Duration.Description: Measured from the latest attempt start to terminal completion; skips never enter this distribution.
Duration.P90Description: Nine in ten completed at or below

Rankings.VolumeDescription: Jobs with the most terminal completions in this window.
Rankings.FailuresDescription: Jobs producing the most failed completions in this window.
Rankings.VolumeEmpty: No terminal job activity completed in this window.
Rankings.FailuresEmpty: No failed executions completed in this window.

Slowest.Description: The slowest measured terminal attempt for each job, linked back to its durable evidence.
Slowest.Empty: No measured terminal attempts completed in this window.

Analytics.CohortNote: State totals describe executions created in the window. Outcomes, throughput, trends, rankings, and durations describe executions completed in the window.

Executions.Title: Execution ledger
Executions.Empty: No durable executions match the current filters.

Filters.InvalidRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.

Cancel.Title: Cancel execution?
Cancel.Message: Queued execution {0} will be cancelled immediately. A running execution receives a durable cooperative cancellation request.

ExecutionDetail.Title: Execution evidence
ExecutionDetail.HistoryDescription: Durable state transitions, worker logs, and operator cancellation evidence.
ExecutionDetail.EmptyHistory: No retained history entries are available.
ExecutionDetail.CancellationPending: A cooperative cancellation request has been pending since {0}.
